description: Search ABCommunity's curated catalog of 25,000+ AI resources: MCP servers, Agent Skills, tools, frameworks, courses, guides and more. Use it for keyword or topic lookups ('postgres', 'browser automation', 'MCP course'). For a goal described in a sentence, prefer find_mcp_for_task. Every filter is strict (results never include other types or unverified items when you ask for verified). Each result has a match label, why it matched, an English and Azerbaijani description, its ABCommunity page and source/repository URL. Page through results with offset/nextOffset. Call get_catalog_overview to see valid capability keys, categories and counts.

capabilities.description: Capability keys the resource must provide, e.g. ['email.read','project.task.create']. See get_catalog_overview.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. agents, ai-coding, data-rag, devops-infra, learning, security, automation

deployment.description: MCP servers only: hosted endpoint (remote) or runs on your machine (local)

language.description: Language of descriptions in the text summary: 'en' (default) or 'az' (Azerbaijani). The JSON always carries both.

official.description: Only resources published by the vendor/maintainer itself

offset.description: Skip this many results (use nextOffset from the previous call)

open_source.description: true = only open-source, false = only closed-source

platform.description: Client the resource is recorded as compatible with, e.g. claude-code. Data is sparse; if nothing matches, results are returned without it and a note says so.

pricing.description: Only resources with this pricing model

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. 'postgres', 'pdf to markdown', 'github mcp'. Omit to browse by filters only.

resource_type.description: Restrict to one type (or a comma-separated list): skill, mcp, tool, framework, course, guide, docs, cookbook, template, starter, boilerplate, prompt, workflow, repository, model, api, dataset, eval, benchmark, design_resource (aliases like 'mcp-server' or 'library' are accepted)

name: search_resources
title: Search ABCommunity resources
